accuracy_notes: Brownfield-register presence was not treated as planning permission, exact developable parcel geometry or guaranteed delivery.
Part 1, Part 2 permission in principle and technical-details consent were kept distinct; permission in principle was not upgraded to full permission.
Experimental brownfield-site geometry was not allowed to override authoritative brownfield-land or cadastral evidence.
Housing Delivery Test evidence remained authority-level and period-exact; no unpublished 2024 or 2025 measurement was invented or downscaled to parcels.
SHLAA/SHELAA inclusion remained technical evidence and was not treated as allocation, policy or permission.
Housing-land-supply and local-plan examination/process evidence was not promoted into parcel permission or Future Growth scores.
Ended and development-complete example records were explicitly rejected from current promotion.
No parcel relation, Future Growth score or business row was fabricated.
